entries.Original: Open the Relicable window. Subcommands: config, novus, braves, questmap, start, stop, reload, booksdone.

entries.Translated: 可靠 - 遗物重生任务地图

entries.Original: Preview any job's Zodiac line, or follow your active job automatically.
entries.Translated: 预览任何工作的生肖线，或自动跟踪您的活动工作。

entries.Original: (pick a job above, or switch to a relic job)
entries.Translated: （选择上面的职业，或者切换到遗迹职业）

entries.Original: Prerequisites (one-time quests attached to the Zodiac line)
entries.Translated: 先决条件（黄道十二宫线附带的一次性任务）
从盖罗尔特（海斯特米尔，北林区）接受。

entries.Original: Select a job to see its material list.
entries.Translated: 选择一个作业以查看其材料列表。

entries.Original: The Braves stage is a quest and materials grind rather than combat content, so it is priced instead of automated: every required material is listed with its market price and a total to buy everything in one go. Grand Company seals, Poetics, and dungeon drops cannot be bought with gil and are listed separately. The eight crafted items can be bought HQ on the board, or crafted via Artisan below.
entries.Translated: 勇敢者阶段是一个任务和材料研磨而不是战斗内容，因此它是定价的而不是自动化的：每种所需的材料都列出了其市场价格和一次性购买所有东西的总数。大公司印章、诗学和地下城掉落物不能用吉尔购买，而是单独列出。八件手工制作的物品可以在板上购买，或者通过下面的 Artisan 制作。
从保留者中获取所有内容

entries.Original: Open a summoning bell, then click: Relicable visits each retainer in turn and retrieves every still-needed material it holds.
entries.Translated: 打开召唤铃，然后单击：Relicable 依次访问每个侍从并取回其所持有的所有仍需要的材料。

entries.Original: material(s) outstanding; the last retainer scan saw
entries.Translated: 未完成的材料；最后一个保持器扫描锯

entries.Original: on a retainer. The dungeon drops are key items and can never be on a retainer.
entries.Translated: 在固定器上。地下城掉落物是关键物品，永远不能放在保留物上。

entries.Original: Nothing outstanding: every market/vendor material on this list is already in your bags.
entries.Translated: 没什么特别的：此列表中的所有市场/供应商材料都已在您的包中。

entries.Original: Stop the retainer fetch. It leaves the retainer UI where it is; close it yourself.
entries.Translated: 停止获取保持器。它将保留 UI 保留在原处；自己关闭它。

entries.Original:
On: the fetch drives the bell and retrieves the stacks itself.
Off: nothing is moved -- open a retainer and the status line lists what to drag out.

Shared with the Novus planner's fetch.
entries.Translated:
开：取指驱动铃声并自行取回堆栈。
关闭：没有任何内容移动 - 打开保留器，状态行列出要拖出的内容。

与 Novus 规划者的获取共享。

entries.Original: A key item -- key items cannot be entrusted to a retainer.
entries.Translated: 关键物品——关键物品不能托付给家臣。

entries.Original: Open a summoning bell, then click: retrieve
entries.Translated: 打开召唤铃，然后点击：检索

entries.Original: The game retrieves whole stacks, so you may get more than the quantity needed.
entries.Translated: 游戏会检索整个堆栈，因此您可能会获得比所需数量更多的内容。

entries.Original: Leave blank to use your home world, or enter a world, data centre, or region name. Shared with the Novus planner.
entries.Translated: 留空以使用您的家乡世界，或输入世界、数据中心或区域名称。与 Novus 规划师共享。

entries.Original:
Check your connection and press 'Refresh prices'.

Detail:
entries.Translated:
检查您的连接并按“刷新价格”。

细节：

entries.Original: Buy what the market lists + gil vendors:
entries.Translated: 购买市场列出的商品+吉尔供应商：

entries.Original: Market listings (HQ for the crafted items) plus the four gil-vendor items. Seals, Poetics, and dungeon drops are not gil-buyable and are shown below.
entries.Translated: 市场列表（手工物品的总部）加上四个吉尔供应商物品。印章、诗学和地下城掉落物不可通过吉尔购买，如下所示。
Gil 供应商（4 个区域项目）：

entries.Original: (4x Bombard Core; or buy on the board)

entries.Translated: 手工制品（购买总部或工艺品）：

entries.Original: still-needed material(s) are on your retainers -- fetch them instead of buying.
entries.Translated: 仍然需要的材料在您的保留中 - 获取它们而不是购买。

entries.Original: tradable item(s) have no current listing, so the market total understates.
entries.Translated: 可交易物品目前没有上市，因此市场总量低估了。

entries.Original: Prices still loading; totals will fill in.
entries.Translated: 价格仍在加载中；将填写总计。

entries.Original: Copy the crafted items and their crafters to the clipboard.
entries.Translated: 将制作的物品及其工匠复制到剪贴板。

entries.Original: Open a summoning bell, then click: retrieve this group's
entries.Translated: 打开召唤铃，然后点击：检索该组的

entries.Original: material(s) from whichever retainers hold them.
entries.Translated: 材料来自固定它们的保持器。
该组中没有什么突出的。

entries.Original: on your retainers at the last scan. Use Fetch to pull them into your bags.
entries.Translated: 上次扫描时在您的固定器上。使用 Fetch 将它们拉入你的包中。
排队工匠进行手工制作

entries.Original: Requires the materials and a levelled crafter.
entries.Translated: 需要材料和水平的工匠。

entries.Original: Open the Duty Finder for this dungeon (does not queue).
entries.Translated: 打开此地牢的任务查找器（不排队）。

entries.Original: Flag this vendor on the map, teleport to the zone, and fly to the flag. Requires vnavmesh, with flight unlocked in the zone.
entries.Translated: 在地图上标记该供应商，传送到该区域，然后飞向该标记。需要 vnavmesh，并在该区域中解锁飞行。

entries.Original: recipe, or buy it on the market board.
entries.Translated: 食谱，或在市场板上购买。

entries.Original: Click to search an open market board for it; with no board open the name is copied to your clipboard.
entries.Translated: 单击以在公开市场板中搜索它；如果没有打开任何板，名称将被复制到剪贴板。

entries.Original: at a materia melder (needs 'Waking the Spirit').
entries.Translated: 在物质融合时（需要“唤醒灵魂”）。

entries.Original: Counted in your own bags only. Once the melded weapon is handed to Gerolt these drop back to zero -- that is expected, the quest has taken it.
entries.Translated: 仅计算在您自己的行李中。一旦融合的武器交给杰罗尔特，这些值就会降为零——这是预料之中的，任务已经完成了。

entries.Original: Flag the market board nearest the Limsa Lominsa Lower Decks aetheryte, teleport there, and walk to the flag. It is the closest board to the teleport point, so you land beside it; then click the weapon or materia above to search for it.
entries.Translated: 标记距离 Limsa Lominsa Lower Decks aetheryte 最近的市场板，传送到那里，然后走到旗帜处。它是距离传送点最近的棋盘，所以你降落在它旁边；然后点击上面的武器或材料来搜索它。

entries.Original: has no crafting recipe in the game data, so it can only be bought.
entries.Translated: 游戏数据中没有制作配方，所以只能购买。

entries.Original: Install and enable Artisan to build a crafting list for this weapon and its pre-crafts.
entries.Translated: 安装并启用 Artisan 来为该武器及其预制件构建制作列表。

entries.Original: Create an Artisan crafting list named "Relicable -
pre-craft it needs. Open Artisan's Crafting Lists to run it.
entries.Translated: 预先制作它需要的。打开 Artisan 的制作列表来运行它。

entries.Original:
A stage is finished when you HOLD its end item, and a finished stage's quests are never taken again.

This has to be judged on the weapon, not the quests: the four Braves material quests are repeatable, so a completed one reads exactly like one you never took — which is why the run used to re-accept 'A Ponze of Flesh' the moment it finished it.

Leave at 1 for a single relic. Raise it to build another (a second job's line, or a second copy) and the stage re-opens until you hold that many.
entries.Translated:
当您持有其最终物品时，阶段就完成了，并且完成阶段的任务将不再被接受。

这必须根据武器而不是任务来判断：四个勇敢者的物质任务是可重复的，因此完成的任务读起来就像你从未接受过的任务一样——这就是为什么游戏在完成后会重新接受“血肉庞兹”的原因。

对于单个遗物，保留为 1。举起它来建造另一个（第二个工作线，或第二个副本），舞台会重新打开，直到你持有那么多。

entries.Original:
Ignore the count above and always offer stage work.

Use this to deliberately re-run a stage on a weapon you already own, or if a finished weapon is somewhere the count cannot see it — a retainer or the glamour dresser rather than your bags or armoury.

With this on, nothing stops a completed stage from repeating.
entries.Translated:
忽略上面的计数并始终提供舞台工作。

使用此功能可以在您已经拥有的武器上故意重新运行一个阶段，或者如果成品武器位于伯爵看不到的地方 - 固定器或魅力梳妆台，而不是您的包或军械库。

启用此功能后，就没有什么可以阻止重复完成的阶段了。

entries.Original:
Who runs the Atma FATE farm.

Built-in: Relicable's own zone-by-zone farm.

CBT Fate Tool Kit: hand the grind to Bundle of Tweaks. Select its 'Atma (Zodiac)' mode once in CBT's own window; Relicable starts and stops the grind and resumes once the atmas are collected.
entries.Translated:
谁经营阿特玛命运农场。

内置：Relicable 自己的逐区域农场。

CBT 命运工具套件：将工作交给 Bundle of Tweaks。在 CBT 自己的窗口中选择“Atma (Zodiac)”模式一次；可靠地开始和停止研磨，并在收集到阿玛斯后恢复。

entries.Original: Requires Bundle of Tweaks. Select 'Atma (Zodiac)' in its Fate Tool Kit window once; the Zenith enhancement itself is left to you, with a prompt when it is ready.
entries.Translated: 需要一系列调整。在“命运工具包”窗口中选择“Atma (Zodiac)”一次； Zenith 增强功能本身由您决定，准备就绪时会有提示。

entries.Original: Atmas per zone, then move on
entries.Translated: 每个区域的阿特玛斯，然后继续前进

entries.Original:
How many of a zone's atma to collect before the farm moves to the next zone.

A single relic only needs one of each (the default). Raise it to bank spare sets for repeat relics in the same trip; the enhancement waits until every zone reaches this target.
entries.Translated:
在农场移动到下一个区域之前要收集多少个区域的阿特玛。

单个遗物只需要其中一个（默认）。将其升起以存储备用套件，以便在同一旅程中重复使用文物；增强会等到每个区域都达到此目标。

entries.Original: BossMod Reborn drives the rotation; Rotation Solver is not required. Relicable installs and uses its own "Relicable Combat" preset by default — leave the field below on Built-in.
entries.Translated: BossMod Reborn 驱动旋转；不需要旋转解算器。默认情况下，Relicable 安装并使用自己的“Relicable Combat”预设 - 将下面的字段保留为“内置”。

entries.Original:
Leave on Built-in (recommended): Relicable's own rotation preset makes BossMod Reborn attack the current hard target, including neutral book enemies — and it is the preset the AoE avoidance setting below is merged into.

Only pick another preset if you built a rotation-only one yourself (Targeting set to Manual). AI presets such as 'VBM Multibox' pick their own targets and skip neutral enemies.
entries.Translated:
保留内置（推荐）：Relicable 自己的旋转预设使 BossMod Reborn 攻击当前的硬目标，包括中立的书籍敌人 - 并且它是下面的 AoE 回避设置合并到的预设。

如果您自己构建了仅旋转预设（目标设置为手动），则仅选择另一个预设。 AI 预设（例如“VBM Multibox”）会选择自己的目标并跳过中立的敌人。

entries.Original: This looks like an AI/movement preset. Use a rotation-only preset here, or BossMod Reborn will pick its own targets (skipping neutral enemies) and fight the navigation for movement.
entries.Translated: 这看起来像是人工智能/动作预设。此处使用仅旋转预设，否则 BossMod Reborn 将选择自己的目标（跳过中立敌人）并与导航进行移动。

entries.Original: This is your avoidance preset, which contains no rotation. Leave the field blank to use Relicable's built-in combat preset.
entries.Translated: 这是您的回避预设，其中不包含旋转。将该字段留空以使用 Relicable 的内置战斗预设。

entries.Original: Inside FATEs, Rotation Solver selects and attacks FATE enemies itself; Relicable navigates into the ring and level-syncs. These options tune that targeting.
entries.Translated: 在 FATE 内部，旋转解算器选择并攻击 FATE 敌人本身；可靠导航到环和电平同步。这些选项可以调整目标。

entries.Original:
How Rotation Solver picks targets inside a FATE.

'All FATE mobs when solo' (recommended) attacks every valid FATE enemy. 'Only already-engaged' waits for enemies to aggro first — for grouped play.
entries.Translated:
旋转解算器如何在 FATE 中选择目标。

“独奏时所有 FATE 生物”（推荐）攻击每个有效的 FATE 敌人。 “仅已交战”等待敌人首先进攻——进行分组游戏。

entries.Original: Ignore non-FATE mobs while in a FATE
entries.Translated: 在 FATE 中忽略非 FATE 生物

entries.Original: Only target FATE enemies while inside a FATE, so combat never wanders onto an unrelated overworld enemy. Recommended on.
entries.Translated: 仅在 FATE 内瞄准 FATE 敌人，因此战斗绝不会转移到不相关的世界敌人身上。推荐上。

entries.Original: Prefer FATE enemies when choosing a target.
entries.Translated: 选择目标时更喜欢FATE敌人。
自动抓取最近的 FATE 暴徒

entries.Original: Automatically pick up the nearest FATE enemy. Applied only inside the FATE and never written to your saved Rotation Solver settings. Requires a recent Rotation Solver; older builds ignore it.
entries.Translated: 自动拾取最近的 FATE 敌人。仅应用于 FATE 内部，并且从未写入您保存的旋转解算器设置。需要最近的旋转解算器；旧版本会忽略它。

entries.Original: Wrath Combo is lease-based: Relicable registers for control while it runs and hands it back when it unloads. Wrath's own window marks the settings Relicable is driving.
entries.Translated: Wrath Combo 是基于租约的：Relicable 在运行时注册控制权，并在卸载时将其交还。 Wrath 自己的窗口标志着 Relicable 正在推动的设置。
让 Relicable 配置 Wrath 的自动旋转

entries.Original:
Recommended on. Relicable clears Wrath's in-combat gating so the rotation will open on a NEUTRAL relic-note enemy, and sets FATE targeting while in a FATE.

Turn it off to have Relicable only switch Auto-Rotation on and off, leaving the rest of your Wrath configuration exactly as you set it.
entries.Translated:
推荐上。 Relicable 清除了“愤怒”的战斗中门控，因此轮换将对中立遗物注敌人开放，并在命运中设置“命运”目标。

将其关闭以仅 Relicable 打开和关闭自动旋转，使 Wrath 配置的其余部分完全按照您的设置进行设置。

entries.Original: With this off, Wrath will not open on a neutral book enemy unless you have already turned off 'In combat only' and 'Only attack in combat' in Wrath yourself — the relic grind will stall.
entries.Translated: 关闭此功能后，除非您自己已经在“愤怒”中关闭了“仅在战斗中”和“仅在战斗中攻击”，否则“愤怒”将不会对中立的敌人开放 - 遗物研磨将停止。

entries.Original:
How Wrath picks targets inside a FATE.

'Highest max HP' favours the FATE boss; 'Nearest' is steadier for FATEs with many adds. 'Manual' hands targeting back to Relicable, which then hard-targets each enemy itself.
entries.Translated:
愤怒如何在命运中选择目标。

“最高最大生命值”有利于 FATE boss； “最近”对于带有许多添加的 FATE 来说更加稳定。 “手动”双手瞄准 Relicable，然后 Relicable 硬瞄准每个敌人本身。

entries.Original: The relic-note grind always pins Wrath to Manual targeting regardless of this setting — those enemies are neutral and have to be pulled off a hard target.
entries.Translated: 不管这个设置如何，遗物笔记研磨总是将愤怒固定在手动瞄准上——这些敌人是中立的，必须从硬目标上拉下来。

entries.Original: Target Ifrit's Infernal Nails first in the Bowl of Embers (Extreme)
entries.Translated: 首先在余烬碗中瞄准伊夫利特的地狱之钉（极限）

entries.Original:
Attack the Infernal Nails before Ifrit — he is invulnerable until every nail is destroyed, and the default target order picks him first.

Applies only while nails are up, is released the moment you leave, and never touches your saved Rotation Solver settings. Works with the standard Rotation Solver plugin.
entries.Translated:
在伊夫利特之前攻击地狱之钉——他是刀枪不入的，直到所有钉子都被摧毁，默认的目标顺序会先选择他。

仅在指甲竖起时应用，在您离开时释放，并且永远不会触及您保存的旋转解算器设置。与标准旋转解算器插件一起使用。

entries.Original: Use the Ifrit EX burst rotation in the Bowl of Embers (Extreme)
entries.Translated: 在余烬碗中使用 Ifrit EX 爆发旋转（极限）

entries.Original:
Requires a custom Rotation Solver build that bundles the 'Ifrit EX Burst' rotations; the official plugin ignores this setting.

When active, entering the duty swaps to your job's burst rotation (tuned for solo unsynced kills on a relic weapon) and your own rotation choice is restored on the way out. If you pick a different rotation inside the duty, Relicable leaves it alone for that visit.
entries.Translated:
需要一个自定义旋转解算器构建，捆绑“Ifrit EX Burst”旋转；官方插件忽略此设置。

当激活时，输入任务会切换到你的工作的爆发轮换（针对遗物武器上的单独不同步杀戮进行调整），并且你自己的轮换选择会在退出时恢复。如果您在任务中选择不同的轮换，Relicable 会在该访问中保留它。
通过 AutoDuty 执行任务

entries.Original:
Relic trials and dungeons are queued and cleared by AutoDuty.

With this off, duty steps cannot run and the relic cannot progress past them.
entries.Translated:
遗物审判和地下城由 AutoDuty 排队和清除。

关闭此功能后，任务步骤将无法运行，而遗物也无法越过它们。
在执行任务前自动装备遗物

entries.Original: Equip the relic from your armoury or bags before each relic duty or hunt, so the drops count. If it cannot be equipped — or with this off — the run pauses and asks you.
entries.Translated: 在每次遗物任务或狩猎之前，从你的军械库或袋子中装备遗物，这样掉落物就很重要。如果无法装备——或者关闭此功能——运行会暂停并询问您。

entries.Original: Kill book monsters that are in FATEs
entries.Translated: 杀死 FATE 中的书本怪物

entries.Original:
Also kill book enemies that are part of a FATE, level-syncing so combat engages them. FATE kills credit the book the same as open-world kills.

Turn off to skip FATE spawns entirely.
entries.Translated:
还要杀死属于命运一部分的书本敌人，进行关卡同步，以便与他们进行战斗。 《FATE》中的杀戮与开放世界中的杀戮相同。

关闭以完全跳过 FATE 生成。

entries.Original: Click a Trials of the Braves book entry to flag + teleport
entries.Translated: 单击《勇敢者试炼》图书条目即可标记 + 传送

entries.Original: With the in-game book open, click an enemy, FATE, or leve entry to flag it on the map and teleport to its zone. Dungeon entries open the Duty Finder. Works even while automation is stopped.
entries.Translated: 打开游戏中的书本，单击敌人、命运或离开条目以将其标记在地图上并传送到其区域。进入地下城会打开任务查找器。即使自动化停止时也能工作。
死亡后恢复（返回和恢复）

entries.Original: Fight back when something aggroes and nothing engages it
entries.Translated: 当有东西发生但没有任何东西参与时进行反击

entries.Original:
A safety net that runs for every step, not just the fighting ones. If an enemy is engaged with you and Relicable is pointed at something else — or at nothing — it stops, targets the attacker and fights back.

This is what covers the steps that otherwise just stand there: waiting for a teleport (which the game refuses while you are in combat), walking to a map flag, or holding at a leve anchor.

It never fires while something already has the attacker targeted, and it stands down inside a FATE, where the FATE step owns targeting and level sync.
entries.Translated:
一张安全网覆盖每一步，而不仅仅是战斗的一步。如果敌人与您交战，并且 Relicable 指向其他物体（或者什么都没有），它就会停下来，瞄准攻击者并进行反击。

这就是那些原本就站在那里的步骤：等待传送（当你在战斗时游戏会拒绝传送）、走到地图标志处或保持水平锚点。

当攻击者已经瞄准某物时，它永远不会触发，并且它会停留在 FATE 中，其中 FATE 步骤拥有目标和级别同步。

entries.Original:
How long an unengaged attacker is tolerated before Relicable stops to deal with it. Measured from when the enemy engaged you.

Three times this while you are still moving, because a mob picked up riding past a camp usually gives up on its own and is not worth stopping for. Default 5.
entries.Translated:
在 Relicable 停止处理之前，可以容忍未参与的攻击者多长时间。从敌人与你交战时开始计算。

当你仍在移动时，这是三倍，因为经过营地的暴徒通常会自行放弃，不值得停下来。默认 5。
将陆行鸟设置为治疗者姿态

entries.Original: Under the BossMod Reborn backend the avoidance movement is merged into the combat preset above, because only one preset can be active at a time. Pick the combat preset there.
entries.Translated: 在 BossMod Reborn 后端下，回避动作被合并到上面的战斗预设中，因为一次只能激活一个预设。在那里选择战斗预设。

entries.Original:
Leave on Built-in (recommended): Relicable installs and uses its own "Relicable Avoidance" preset, which contains movement only — it dodges AoE without ever touching your target.

Only pick another preset if you built a movement-only one yourself. Do NOT pick an AI preset such as 'VBM Multibox': those include AutoTarget, which overwrites your target every frame and fights whichever plugin is running your rotation.
entries.Translated:
保持内置（推荐）：Relicable 安装并使用自己的“Relicablevoidance”预设，其中仅包含移动 - 它可以在不接触目标的情况下躲避 AoE。

如果您自己构建了仅运动的预设，则仅选择另一个预设。不要选择诸如“VBM Multibox”之类的 AI 预设：其中包括 AutoTarget，它会在每一帧上覆盖您的目标，并与运行您的旋转的任何插件进行战斗。

entries.Original: This looks like an AI/movement preset. It will overwrite your target every frame and fight your combat plugin for control. Choose Built-in to use Relicable's own avoidance preset instead.
entries.Translated: 这看起来像是人工智能/动作预设。它会在每一帧覆盖你的目标并与你的战斗插件争夺控制权。选择“内置”以使用 Relicable 自己的回避预设。

entries.Original: This is Relicable's rotation preset — it contains no movement, so you would get no avoidance at all. Choose Built-in.
entries.Translated: 这是 Relicable 的旋转预设 - 它不包含任何移动，因此你根本不会躲避。选择内置。

entries.Original:
Avoidance only acts while you are standing still, and steps aside for vnavmesh while it is moving you — so it dodges between navigation legs, not during travel.

BossMod Reborn ships no scripted timelines for ARR overworld content, so in FATEs it can only sidestep what it infers from an enemy's live cast. Expect partial coverage, not a clean dodge of everything.
entries.Translated:
回避仅在您静止不动时起作用，并在 vnavmesh 移动您时为 vnavmesh 闪避 - 因此它会在导航腿之间闪避，而不是在旅行期间闪避。

BossMod Reborn 没有为 ARR 世界内容提供脚本化的时间表，因此在 FATE 中它只能回避从敌人的实时施放中推断出的内容。期待部分覆盖，而不是完全回避一切。

entries.Original: Farm Alexandrite endlessly (do not stop at the target)
entries.Translated: 无尽地农场紫翠玉（不要停在目标处）

entries.Original: Keep the Mysterious Map farm running and restocking past the Alexandrite target until you press Stop.
entries.Translated: 保持神秘地图农场运行并重新放养经过亚历山大变石目标，直到您按下“停止”。

entries.Original:
How long to wait at an unspawned book FATE before rotating to the next one.

The first pass just glances at each FATE; later passes wait this many seconds. 0 waits indefinitely. Default 120.
entries.Translated:
在一本未生成的书《FATE》上等待多长时间才能转到下一本。

第一关只是扫一眼每个FATE；稍后经过等待这么多秒。 0 无限期等待。默认 120。

entries.Original: Drop level sync to survive a FATE you are losing
entries.Translated: 降低关卡同步以在你正在失去的命运中生存

entries.Original:
Level sync is what lets you fight a FATE — and what lets a FATE boss kill you. Below the health threshold, Relicable turns sync off: you go back to full level, full health and full mitigation against enemies now far beneath you.

That FATE will not credit, which is the point — dying costs far more, since recovery returns you to a home aetheryte and restarts the objective from its teleport. It does NOT fire if the enemy is going to die before you do.
entries.Translated:
关卡同步可以让你与 FATE 战斗，也可以让 FATE boss 杀死你。低于生命值阈值，Relicable 会关闭同步：你会回到满等级、满生命值并充分缓解现在远在你下方的敌人。

命运不会相信，这就是重点——死亡的代价要高得多，因为恢复会让你回到一个以太体并从它的传送重新启动目标。如果敌人先于你死亡，它就不会开火。
将同步降到以下（健康百分比）
重新同步以上（健康百分比）

entries.Original: Health at which the run syncs back in and resumes FATEs. Keep it well clear of the drop threshold so a couple of ticks of regen cannot bounce you straight back into the fight that just went wrong.
entries.Translated: 运行同步回来并恢复 FATE 的健康状况。让它远离掉落阈值，这样几次恢复就不会让你直接回到刚刚出错的战斗中。

entries.Original: The re-sync threshold must be above the drop threshold, or the run will sync straight back in at the health it just bailed out at.
entries.Translated: 重新同步阈值必须高于下降阈值，否则运行将直接同步回到刚刚退出的运行状况。

entries.Original: Grab FATEs that are already up nearby
entries.Translated: 抓住附近已经存在的 FATE

entries.Original:
Take a book FATE that is live in the zone you are STANDING IN before travelling anywhere else, and take one in a zone where you also have enemy work so a single teleport covers both. Only triggers when the FATE has enough time left to reach and clear.

Turn this off for the strict enemies, leves, dungeons, then FATEs order regardless of what is live.
entries.Translated:
在前往其他地方之前，在您所在的区域中拿一本《命运》，然后在您也有敌人工作的区域中拿一本，这样一次传送就可以覆盖这两个区域。仅当 FATE 有足够的时间到达并清除时才会触发。

对于严格的敌人、关卡、地下城，关闭此功能，然后无论实时情况如何，命运都会命令。

entries.Original: Use Aetheryte Tickets for expensive teleports
entries.Translated: 使用 Aetheryte 门票进行昂贵的传送

entries.Original: Spend an Aetheryte Ticket instead of gil when the destination costs at least the amount below. Falls back to gil automatically when you have no tickets left.
entries.Translated: 当目的地花费至少低于以下金额时，花费一张 Aetheryte 门票而不是 gil。当您没有剩余门票时，会自动回退到 gil。

entries.Original: Use a ticket at or above (gil)
entries.Translated: 使用 (gil) 或以上的门票

entries.Original: Compared against the game's own price for that destination, so favoured and free destinations are priced correctly. Cheap hops stay on gil and the tickets are saved for the long jumps. Default 300.
entries.Translated: 与该目的地的游戏本身价格相比，受青睐和免费目的地的定价是正确的。便宜的啤酒花留在吉尔上，并且可以节省跳远的门票。默认 300。

entries.Original:
The duty AutoDuty farms for Light. 295 = the Bowl of Embers (Extreme), the standard fast farm.

Use AutoDuty's '/autoduty tt <duty name>' to look up another duty's id.
entries.Translated:
轻型 AutoDuty 农场。 295 = 余烬之碗（极限），标准快速农场。

使用 AutoDuty 的“/autoduty tt <职责名称>”查找另一个职责的 ID。

entries.Original: Upper bound on AutoDuty loops per hand-off. Farming stops automatically at full Light regardless.
entries.Translated: 每次切换的 AutoDuty 循环上限。无论如何，耕作在全光照时会自动停止。

entries.Original: Run unsynced / unrestricted (solo at max level)
entries.Translated: 不同步/不受限制地运行（最高级别独奏）

entries.Original: Run the duty unsynced so a single max-level character can solo it. Turn off for a synced party.
entries.Translated: 不同步地运行任务，这样单个最高级别的角色就可以独奏它。为同步聚会关闭。

entries.Original: The duty AutoDuty farms to charge each Mahatma. 295 = the Bowl of Embers (Extreme), the fastest farm. 172 = the Aurum Vale, a dungeon alternative. AutoDuty needs a path for the chosen duty.
entries.Translated: AutoDuty 农场负责向每位圣雄收费。 295 = 余烬之碗（极限），最快的农场。 172 = Aurum Vale，地下城的替代品。 AutoDuty 需要一条用于所选职责的路径。

entries.Original: Duties per AutoDuty hand-off. 1 keeps the loop tight; farming stops the moment a Mahatma awakens regardless.
entries.Translated: 根据 AutoDuty 交接的职责。 1 保持环紧；不管怎样，圣雄醒来的那一刻农业就停止了。

entries.Original: Run the duty unsynced so a single max-level character can solo it. Each Mahatma is attached at Remon automatically; the final step at Jalzahn is left to you (it needs the relic unequipped).
entries.Translated: 不同步地运行任务，这样单个最高级别的角色就可以独奏它。每个圣雄都会自动附在雷蒙； Jalzahn 的最后一步留给你（它需要未装备的遗物）。

entries.Original: Abandon Ifrit EX when the Infernal Nails spawn
entries.Translated: 当地狱之钉生成时放弃伊夫利特 EX

entries.Original:
When farming the Bowl of Embers (Extreme), leave and re-enter if the Infernal Nails spawn instead of waiting out Ifrit's invulnerability. AutoDuty re-queues automatically.

Turn off to fight the nails instead — for a job or gear that cannot burst him down first.
entries.Translated:
当耕种余烬之碗（极限）时，如果地狱之钉生成，请离开并重新进入，而不是等待伊夫利特的刀枪不入。 AutoDuty 自动重新排队。

转而去对抗钉子——为了一份不能首先让他崩溃的工作或装备。

entries.Original: Keep gear sets on the current relic
entries.Translated: 将齿轮组保留在当前遗迹上

entries.Original:
Each upgrade replaces the relic with a new item, so a gear set that named the old one comes up with an empty main hand afterwards.

When on, the gear set you are wearing is updated to the new weapon after an upgrade -- only when it is for the job you are on and nothing but the weapon would change.
entries.Translated:
每次升级都会用新物品替换遗物，因此名为旧物品的装备组随后会出现空主手。

启用后，您佩戴的装备组会在升级后更新为新武器 - 仅当它适合您正在从事的工作并且除了武器之外什么都不会改变时。

entries.Original:
The 'Fetch from retainers' actions (Novus route materia, Braves shopping list) drive the summoning bell themselves, cycling through every retainer and pulling what is needed into your bags.

Turn off to only list what to withdraw.
entries.Translated:
“从随从中获取”动作（Novus 路线材料、勇士队购物清单）会自行驱动召唤铃，循环遍历每个随从并将所需物品拉入您的包中。

关闭以仅列出要撤回的内容。

entries.Original:
Delete drop clutter from your bags as it accumulates, so a long unattended run does not stop looting on a full inventory.

Only items known to drop from an enemy are ever eligible. Anything crafted, gathered, fished, bought, desynthed or unrecognised is left alone no matter how it is configured.

There is no confirmation window and nothing to answer — items go immediately and permanently. The table below shows exactly what would go right now.
entries.Translated:
清除行李中堆积的杂物，这样长时间无人看管的运行并不能阻止对完整库存的掠夺。

只有已知从敌人身上掉落的物品才有资格。任何制作、采集、捕鱼、购买、分解或未被识别的东西，无论其配置如何，都将被保留。

没有确认窗口，也无需回答——物品会立即永久消失。下表准确显示了现在会发生什么。

entries.Original: Off. Nothing is ever deleted while this is unticked.
entries.Translated: 离开。未勾选此选项时，不会删除任何内容。

entries.Original: The enemy-drop catalogue (Data/catalogs/mob_drop_items.json) could not be loaded, so nothing will be discarded. Reinstall the plugin, or regenerate it with tools/gen_mob_drops.py.
entries.Translated: 无法加载敌人掉落目录（Data/catalogs/mob_drop_items.json），因此不会丢弃任何内容。重新安装插件，或使用tools/gen_mob_drops.py重新生成它。

entries.Original: Discarded items are gone permanently — there is no confirmation and no way to get them back. Check the table below before leaving a long run unattended.
entries.Translated: 丢弃的物品将永久消失——无法确认，也无法取回。在无人看管长时间运行之前请检查下表。

entries.Original: Eligible items are limited to the
entries.Translated: 符合资格的物品仅限于

entries.Original: known enemy drops; everything else in
entries.Translated: 已知的敌人掉落；其他一切都在

entries.Original: your bags is protected regardless of the settings below.
entries.Translated: 无论以下设置如何，您的行李都会受到保护。

entries.Original:
Both settings only ever act on items known to drop from an enemy.

'Only my discard list' deletes nothing except the items you tick below — predictable, but you have to seed it once.

'All low-value materials' is the hands-off setting: enemy drops that are also ordinary white, stackable, non-usable materials worth at most the vendor price below. Gear, anything usable, HQ, collectables, materia and every relic material are excluded no matter what.
entries.Translated:
这两种设置都只作用于已知从敌人身上掉落的物品。

“仅我的丢弃列表”除了您在下面勾选的项目外不会删除任何内容 - 这是可以预见的，但您必须为其播种一次。

“所有低价值材料”是不干涉的设置：敌人掉落的物品也是普通的白色、可堆叠、不可使用的材料，其价值至多低于供应商价格。无论如何，装备、任何可用的东西、总部、收藏品、材料和所有遗物材料都被排除在外。

entries.Original: Recommended on: nothing is deleted while you are playing normally, only during a run. Turn off to keep the bags clear all the time.
entries.Translated: 建议：正常玩游戏时不会删除任何内容，仅在跑步期间删除。关闭以始终保持袋子清洁。

entries.Original: Discard at or under (gil to a vendor)
entries.Translated: 等于或低于（吉尔给供应商）丢弃

entries.Original:
Compared against what a vendor pays for the item. ARR mob drops sit in the single and double digits, so the default of 100 keeps anything actually worth carrying.

This is a vendor price, not a market price — raise it carefully.
entries.Translated:
与供应商为该商品支付的价格进行比较。 ARR 怪物掉落量为个位数和两位数，因此默认值 100 会保留任何真正值得携带的东西。

这是供应商价格，而不是市场价格——谨慎提高。

entries.Original: 'Keep' never deletes that item again. 'Discard' always deletes it, even in list-only mode. Protected rows are ones the rules refuse to touch — most often because the item is not a known enemy drop (crafted, gathered, bought, desynthed), and also gear, usable items, HQ, materia and relic materials. Protected items cannot be forced onto the discard list.
entries.Translated: “保留”永远不会再次删除该项目。即使在仅列表模式下，“丢弃”始终会删除它。受保护的行是规则拒绝触及的行——最常见的是因为该物品不是已知的敌人掉落物（制作、收集、购买、分解），还有装备、可用物品、总部、材料和遗物材料。受保护的项目不能被强制列入丢弃列表。

entries.Original: Status of the plugins Relicable drives. Required items must be installed AND expose their IPC before automation will start.
entries.Translated: 插件的状态 可靠的驱动器。在自动化开始之前，必须安装所需的项目并公开其 IPC。

entries.Original: Repo links open the project page. Copy adds the Dalamud custom-repository URL to your clipboard; paste it in /xlsettings > Experimental > Custom Plugin Repositories.
entries.Translated: 存储库链接可打开项目页面。复制将 Dalamud 自定义存储库 URL 添加到剪贴板；将其粘贴到 /xlsettings > 实验 > 自定义插件存储库中。

entries.Original: Re-read BossMod Reborn's preset list. Use this if you created a preset in BossMod Reborn while this window was open.
entries.Translated: 重新阅读 BossMod Reborn 的预设列表。如果您在此窗口打开时在 BossMod Reborn 中创建了预设，请使用此选项。

entries.Original: Relic Stage: Relic (from A Relic Reborn quest)
entries.Translated: 遗物阶段：遗物（来自遗物重生任务）

entries.Original: CBT's Fate Tool Kit is running, so Relicable has stepped aside to avoid fighting it for movement.
entries.Translated: CBT 的命运工具包正在运行，因此 Relicable 已退到一边以避免与它争夺行动。

entries.Original: Disable the Fate Tool Kit, or set the Atma backend to it in Settings so the two coordinate.
entries.Translated: 禁用 Fate Tool Kit，或者在“设置”中将 Atma 后端设置为它，以便两者协调。

entries.Original:
Opens the Trials of the Braves book.
Click any entry inside it to flag the target on the map and travel there.
entries.Translated:
打开《勇敢者试炼》一书。
单击其中的任何条目即可在地图上标记目标并前往那里。

entries.Original:
Flags Jalzahn (Hyrstmill, North Shroud) and teleports you to him.
Pick the enhancement from his menu, or press Start to automate it.
entries.Translated:
标记贾尔赞（Hyrstmill、北林地）并将你传送到他身边。
从菜单中选择增强功能，或按“开始”以使其自动化。

entries.Original: on the map and teleports you there.
entries.Translated: 在地图上并将您传送到那里。

entries.Original: Flags this objective's location on the map and teleports you there.
entries.Translated: 在地图上标记此目标的位置并将您传送到那里。

entries.Original: held), yellow = partial or on a retainer, grey = none.
entries.Translated: 持有），黄色 = 部分或有固定器，灰色 = 无。

entries.Original: Click an atma to teleport to its farm zone.
entries.Translated: 单击一个atma可以传送到它的农场区域。

entries.Original: Retainer counts come from the summoning bell and reflect the last time each retainer was opened.
entries.Translated: 保持器计数来自召唤铃，反映了每个保持器上次打开的时间。

entries.Original: No farm zone is loaded for this atma.
entries.Translated: 没有为此 atma 加载农场区域。

entries.Original: Work every kind of book entry, in the usual order: enemies, then leves, then dungeons, then FATEs.
entries.Translated: 按照通常的顺序处理各种书籍条目：敌人，然后关卡，然后地下城，然后命运。

entries.Original: Only work the kinds you tick below. Everything else in the book is left alone.
entries.Translated: 仅适用于您在下面勾选的类型。书中的其他内容均保留原样。

entries.Original: Run the book's levequests. These spend leve allowances.
entries.Translated: 运行本书的级别任务。这些支出都是津贴。

entries.Original: Queue and clear the book's dungeons (needs AutoDuty).
entries.Translated: 排队并清除书中的地牢（需要 AutoDuty）。

entries.Original: Wait for and clear the book's FATEs.
Nothing is ticked, so there is no book work to do. The engine will ignore this filter rather than stop, until you tick something or switch back to Auto.
entries.Translated: 没有勾选任何内容，因此没有书本工作可做。引擎将忽略此过滤器而不是停止，直到您勾选某些内容或切换回“自动”。

entries.Original: is unticked, so the engine will not pick this on its own. "Run next" still runs it once.
entries.Translated: 未勾选，因此引擎不会自行选择此选项。 “运行下一个”仍然运行一次。

entries.Original: Picked - it will run when you press Start.
entries.Translated: 已选择 - 当您按开始时它将运行。

entries.Original: Pins work to this stage; lets you go back to a farmable stage.
entries.Translated: 引脚工作到此阶段；让你回到可耕作的阶段。

entries.Original: Currently on the base relic: work 'A Relic Reborn'. The questmap below shows the prerequisites, parts, and materials.
entries.Translated: 目前在基础遗迹上：作品“遗迹重生”。下面的任务地图显示了先决条件、零件和材料。
打开遗物重生任务地图

entries.Original: Prerequisites, the ten quest parts, and materials for A Relic Reborn, all checked live against your character.
entries.Translated: 《遗迹重生》的先决条件、十个任务部分和材料，全部针对您的角色进行实时检查。

entries.Original: Your materia across bags and retainers, plus the cheapest melding route in order.
entries.Translated: 您的袋子和固定器上的材料，以及按顺序最便宜的融合路线。

entries.Original: The full Zodiac Braves shopping list with market prices, a buy-it-all total, and Artisan crafting.
entries.Translated: 完整的 Zodiac Braves 购物清单，包括市场价格、全部购买总额和工匠制作。

entries.Original: Halt movement immediately. Use if the character is stuck mid-path.
entries.Translated: 立即停止运动。如果角色被困在路径中途，则使用。

entries.Original: Cancel pathfinding and reload this zone's navmesh. Fixes most stuck states.
entries.Translated: 取消寻路并重新加载该区域的导航网格。修复了大多数卡住的状态。

entries.Original: All 12 charged: unequip the relic and pick 'Zodiac Weapon Awakening' at Jalzahn (Hyrstmill, North Shroud).
entries.Translated: 全部 12 人已充能：卸下遗物并在 Jalzahn（Hyrstmill、North Shroud）选择“Zodiac Weapon Awakening”。

entries.Original:
.
Equipped or in the armoury chest both count.
entries.Translated:
。
装备或在军械库箱子中都算数。

entries.Original: Start buys the mist from Auriana (Revenant's Toll, 20 poetics each), then trades at the Furnace beside Gerolt (Hyrstmill).
entries.Translated: Start从Auriana（Revenant's Toll，每人20诗学）处购买迷雾，然后在Geolt（Hyrstmill）旁边的熔炉进行交易。

entries.Original: Start goes straight to the Furnace beside Gerolt (Hyrstmill, North Shroud) and trades it.
entries.Translated: 斯塔特直接前往杰罗尔特旁边的熔炉（北林区海斯特磨坊）并进行交易。

entries.Original: Hand it to Gerolt (Hyrstmill) when melded; Start drives that turn-in and the Chimera after it.
entries.Translated: 融合后交给 Gerolt (Hyrstmill)；开始驾驶该交接，并在其后驾驶奇美拉。

entries.Original: Next step (Animus): buy your first Trials of the Braves book
entries.Translated: 下一步（Animus）：购买你的第一本《勇敢者试炼》书

entries.Original: From G'Jusana (Rowena's House of Splendors, Mor Dhona; 100 poetics). Start does this automatically.
entries.Translated: 来自 G'Jusana（罗威纳的辉煌之家，Mor Dhona；100 首诗）。启动会自动执行此操作。

entries.Original: ' to its NPC and move on to the rest of the run.
entries.Translated: ' 给它的 NPC，然后继续剩下的路程。

entries.Original: Only THIS report is skipped (the quest's step
entries.Translated: 仅跳过此报告（任务步骤

entries.Original: ); once the quest advances, the next

' and carry on with the rest of the trip.
That one quest stays skipped for the whole session; the other stops on this trip still run.
entries.Translated:
'并继续剩下的旅程。
该任务在整个会话中都会被跳过；此行程的其他站点仍在运行。

entries.Original: A report only advances the quest when you hold everything that step asks for, including the vendor/crafted/seals items the engine does not farm -- see /relic braves.
entries.Translated: 只有当你持有该步骤要求的所有物品时，报告才会推进任务，包括引擎不耕种的供应商/制作/密封物品 - 请参阅/遗迹勇敢者。

entries.Original: Sequence 0 is what reads as "not in hand" -- these quests are repeatable, so a finished one looks exactly like one you never took.
entries.Translated: 序列 0 读作“不在手中”——这些任务是可重复的，所以完成的任务看起来和你从未接过的任务一模一样。

entries.Original: Stop/Start keeps it skipped; reload the plugin to un-skip it.
entries.Translated: 停止/启动使其跳过；重新加载插件以取消跳过它。

entries.Original: Equip your Novus relic to track and farm Light.
entries.Translated: 装备你的 Novus 遗物来追踪和种植光。

entries.Original: Open the Sphere Scroll's window once so its infused count can be read.
entries.Translated: 打开球体卷轴的窗口一次，以便可以读取其注入计数。

entries.Original: Driving a summoning bell to pull the quest materials your retainers hold.
entries.Translated: 驾驶召唤铃来拉出你的随从持有的任务材料。

entries.Original: Animus enhancement at Jalzahn (Hyrstmill): the filled Sphere Scroll + the unequipped Animus weapon.
entries.Translated: Jalzahn (Hyrstmill) 的 Animus 增强：填充的球体卷轴 + 未装备的 Animus 武器。

entries.Original: All 12 Mahatma charged; finish at Jalzahn yourself (relic unequipped).
entries.Translated: 12名圣雄全部被指控；自己在贾尔赞完成任务（遗物未装备）。

entries.Original: ); attaches at Remon, farms via AutoDuty.
entries.Translated: ）；通过 AutoDuty 连接到 Remon 农场。

entries.Original: Equip your Zodiac Braves weapon to charge Mahatma.
entries.Translated: 装备你的 Zodiac Braves 武器来冲锋圣雄。

entries.Original: Runs step by step (no single progress gauge).
entries.Translated: 逐步运行（没有单一进度表）。

entries.Original:
The most stats the route may spread melds across.

More stats stay in the cheap low grades; fewer force the expensive high grades. Only affects stats beyond those already infused (see below).
entries.Translated:
该路线可能传播的最多统计数据融合在一起。

更多统计数据停留在廉价的低等级；少力高品位贵。只影响超出已注入的统计数据（见下文）。

entries.Original: 'Max stats' only adds NEW stats beyond those.
entries.Translated: “最大统计数据”仅添加除这些之外的新统计数据。

entries.Original: Clear the per-stat 'Already infused' values. A fresh scroll should start at 0 — stale values from a previous scroll pin the plan and make 'Max stats' look inert.
entries.Translated: 清除每个统计数据“已注入”值。新的滚动应该从 0 开始——前一个滚动的陈旧值会固定计划并使“最大统计数据”看起来惰性。

entries.Original:
'Fetch from Retainer' drives the summoning bell itself, cycling through every retainer and pulling the route's materia into your bags.

Turn off to only list what to withdraw. Either way the route shows retainer stock, and melding always sources from your bags. Shared with the Braves planner's fetch buttons.
entries.Translated:
“从侍从获取”会驱动召唤铃，循环穿过每个侍从，并将路线的材料拉入你的包中。

关闭以仅列出要撤回的内容。无论哪种方式，路线都会显示固定库存，并且融合始终来自您的行李。与勇敢者计划者的获取按钮共享。

entries.Original: How many Alexandrite to hold before the treasure-map farm stops (one per meld; 75 fills a scroll). Raising it re-arms the farm. 0 disables the target.
entries.Translated: 在藏宝图农场停止之前需要持有多少颗紫翠玉（每组一颗；75 颗紫翠玉填满一卷轴）。举起它可以重新武装农场。 0 禁用目标。

entries.Original: Set how many points each stat already has on the scroll. The route continues each stat from its current grade and skips maxed stats. Keep these updated as you infuse.
entries.Translated: 设置滚动条上每个统计数据已有的点数。该路线从当前等级继续每个统计数据并跳过最大统计数据。在输注时保持这些更新。

entries.Original: Zero every stat. Do this when starting a fresh Sphere Scroll so the plan starts from scratch.
entries.Translated: 每个统计数据归零。在开始新的球体卷轴时执行此操作，以便计划从头开始。

entries.Original:
Experimental: drives the Materia Melding window to infuse the route automatically. Open your Sphere Scroll's melding window first, and test with cheap materia — a wrong confirm can destroy materia.

When off, the route is computed and sourced but you infuse it yourself.
entries.Translated:
实验：驱动材质融合窗口自动注入路线。首先打开你的球体卷轴的融合窗口，并使用廉价的材料进行测试 - 错误的确认可能会破坏材料。

关闭时，将计算并获取路线，但您可以自行注入。

entries.Original: Leave blank to use your home world, or enter a world, data centre, or region name.
entries.Translated: 留空以使用您的家乡世界，或输入世界、数据中心或区域名称。

entries.Original: Actions (run without starting the main automation)
entries.Translated: 操作（在不启动主自动化的情况下运行）

entries.Original: Open the Materia Melding window on your Sphere Scroll first, then click. Progress shows in the Status line below.
entries.Translated: 首先打开球体卷轴上的材质融合窗口，然后单击。进度显示在下面的状态行中。

entries.Original:
Open a retainer at the bell ('Entrust or withdraw items'), then click.

With 'Pull materia from retainers' on, the route's materia is retrieved into your bags one stack at a time; with it off, this lists what to withdraw. With no retainer open it reports which retainers hold what you still need.
entries.Translated:
在铃声处打开保留器（“委托或提取物品”），然后单击。

启用“从固定器中提取材料”后，路线的材料会一次一堆地取回您的包中；关闭后，会列出要撤回的内容。在没有打开固定器的情况下，它会报告哪些固定器保存着您仍然需要的东西。

entries.Original: Sphere Scroll: not read yet - open the scroll's melding window once.
entries.Translated: 球体卷轴：尚未阅读 - 打开卷轴的融合窗口一次。

entries.Original: The infused count can only be read while the RelicSphereScroll window is open. Open it once (even without melding) and the count is remembered from then on, including for a scroll you melded by hand.
entries.Translated: 仅当 RelicSphereScroll 窗口打开时才能读取注入的计数。打开一次（即使没有融合），从那时起计数就会被记住，包括您手工融合的卷轴。

entries.Original: - ready to hand in at Jalzahn.
Read from the scroll's own counter the last time its window was open. Melding updates it automatically; at the cap the run moves on to Jalzahn on its own.
entries.Translated: 从卷轴自己的计数器读取其窗口上次打开的时间。 Melding会自动更新；到达终点后，车队自行前往贾尔赞 (Jalzahn)。

entries.Original: The scroll is at its cap. Press Start on the main window and the run travels to Jalzahn for the 'Relic Weapon Animus Enhancement' (the Animus weapon is unequipped for the turn-in and the Novus weapon re-equipped afterwards), or go yourself with the button.
entries.Translated: 卷轴位于其顶部。按主窗口上的“开始”，然后跑到 Jalzahn 进行“遗物武器阿尼穆斯增强”（阿尼穆斯武器在交接时未装备，然后重新装备诺维斯武器），或者自己按下按钮。

entries.Original: Flags Jalzahn (Hyrstmill, North Shroud), teleports to Fallgourd Float and flies there.
entries.Translated: 标记 Jalzahn（海斯特磨坊、北林地），传送到 Fallgourd Float 并飞到那里。

entries.Original: Route: use your materia first, then cheapest (in order)
entries.Translated: 路线：首先使用你的材料，然后是最便宜的（按顺序）

entries.Original: No route yet. Prices may still be loading.
entries.Translated: 还没有路线。价格可能仍在加载中。

entries.Original:
What you still need to buy at the cheapest current listings, after the materia you already own (bags + retainers).

Failed melds destroy materia, so the counts are expected values — stock a few extra of the lossy higher grades. '(some prices missing)' means a needed grade has no listing.
entries.Translated:
在您已经拥有的材料（袋子+保持器）之后，您仍然需要在当前最便宜的列表中购买什么。

失败的融合会破坏材料，因此计数是预期值 - 储备一些额外的有损较高等级。 “（缺少某些价格）”表示所需等级没有列出。

entries.Original: Click to search an open market board for
entries.Translated: 单击以搜索公开市场板

entries.Original: ; with none open, the name is copied to your clipboard.
entries.Translated: ;如果没有打开，名称将复制到剪贴板。
保持器材料（在门铃处扫描）

entries.Original: No retainers scanned yet. Open each retainer at a summoning bell (or let AutoRetainer run) to record what they hold.
entries.Translated: 尚未扫描保持器。在召唤铃处打开每个保持器（或让 AutoRetainer 运行）以记录它们所持有的内容。
勇敢者自动获取已停止。

entries.Original: Stopped: another retainer fetch took over.
entries.Translated: 已停止：另一个保留者获取接管。

entries.Original: Fetch: open a retainer at the bell to list what to withdraw.
entries.Translated: 获取：在铃声处打开保留器以列出要提取的内容。

entries.Original: Fetch: open the summoning bell and
will be pulled from every retainer.
entries.Translated: 将从每个保持器中拉出。

entries.Original: Fetched everything; closing the retainer window...
entries.Translated: 一切都已取来；关闭固定窗口...
一切都已取来；留下保持器...

entries.Original: Could not retrieve (retainer window not ready).
entries.Translated: 无法检索（固定器窗口未准备好）。

entries.Original: This retainer is done; leaving it...
entries.Translated: 这个固定器就完成了；留下它...

entries.Original: This retainer is done; returning to the list...
entries.Translated: 这个固定器就完成了；返回列表...
正在打开“委托或提取物品”...

entries.Original: Checked every retainer -- still short on some of
entries.Translated: 检查了每一个保持器——仍然缺少一些

entries.Original: will be pulled from every retainer.
entries.Translated: 将从每个保持器中拉出。

entries.Original: Open a retainer at the summoning bell; this lists what to drag out.
entries.Translated: 在召唤钟处打开保持器；这列出了要拖出的内容。

entries.Original: This retainer has nothing to pull for this list -- open another retainer, or press Stop.
entries.Translated: 此保持器对此列表无任何作用 - 打开另一个保持器，或按“停止”。

entries.Original: Nothing to infuse: the route is empty (scroll complete, or 'Already infused' is at the cap).
entries.Translated: 没有可注入的内容：路线是空的（滚动完成，或者“已注入”位于上限）。

entries.Original: Infusing: open your Sphere Scroll's melding window while holding the route's materia.
entries.Translated: 注入：按住路线材料的同时打开球体卷轴的融合窗口。

entries.Original: Nothing to fetch (route empty or already in your bags).
entries.Translated: 没有东西可以拿（路线空着或已经在你的包里）。

entries.Original: Could not open the Sphere Scroll window (is the scroll in your inventory?).
entries.Translated: 无法打开球体卷轴窗口（卷轴在您的库存中吗？）。

entries.Original: infused. Press Start to hand it to Jalzahn for the Novus enhancement.
entries.Translated: 注入。按“开始”将其交给 Jalzahn 进行 Novus 增强。

entries.Original: Infuse made no progress (prompt unhandled or out of materia). See the log.
entries.Translated: 注入没有任何进展（提示未处理或超出材料）。查看日志。

entries.Original: Looking for an infusable materia (holding the route's materia?)...
entries.Translated: 寻找可注入的材料（持有路线的材料？）...

entries.Original: Complete A Relic Reborn: The Chimera

entries.Translated: 终极武器（ARR MSQ 结局）

entries.Original: Class and job quests to level 50
entries.Translated: 等级和工作任务达到 50 级

entries.Original: Base relic complete - next: trade for Zenith at the Furnace
entries.Translated: 基础遗物完成 - 下一步：在熔炉处交易 Zenith

entries.Original: Base relic complete - next: trade for Zenith at the Furnace (x
entries.Translated: 基础遗物完成 - 下一步：在熔炉处交易 Zenith (x

entries.Original: Atma complete - next: buy the first Animus book
entries.Translated: Atma 完成 - 下一步：购买第一本 Animus 书
